The [[Azzameen family]] conducted a '''mission''' to recapture the [[Comm Datacore|family datacore]], which had been discarded and transported to [[Junkyard Control]] from their home, the [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] [[Space station/Legends|station]] [[Azzameen Station/Legends|Azzameen Home Base]], following the station's [[Imperialization of Azzameen assets|capture]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The family required the [[Datacore/Legends|datacore]] for the information it contained regarding the Empire and an Imperial-aligned [[Merchant/Legends|trading]] company, [[Viraxo Industries]], in order to conduct further missions against both factions.
